rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Scans MCP servers for security vulnerabilities including 15+ prompt injection patterns, 17 credential leak patterns, and 28 sensitive endpoint paths. Generates CVSS-scored findings with remediation guidance in HTML and JSON formats. Available as a CLI tool, Python SDK, and as an MCP server itself with both stdio and SSE transport options.
